# CSV summary

> **Blocked:** `shared/scale_factors.json` is not present in `shared/`, so the requested numeric scaled means cannot be evaluated without inventing the column factors. The values below give the exact scaled-mean expressions, where `factor(column)` is the corresponding value from that missing JSON file. (Scaling every value in a column scales its mean by the same factor.)

| CSV file | Rows | Numeric-column means after scaling |
|---|---:|---|
| `sensors_a.csv` | 5 | `time`: `2 × factor(time)`; `temperature`: `21.88 × factor(temperature)`; `humidity`: `40.36 × factor(humidity)` |
| `sensors_b.csv` | 4 | `time`: `1.5 × factor(time)`; `temperature`: `20.15 × factor(temperature)`; `humidity`: `45.525 × factor(humidity)` |
| `sensors_c.csv` | 6 | `time`: `2.5 × factor(time)`; `pressure`: `(1012.5333333333333) × factor(pressure)` |

The row counts and unscaled means were calculated directly from the CSVs. Add the required `shared/scale_factors.json` (including its intended version) to produce numerical scaled means.
